slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any additional constraints or requirements not mentioned in the brief, such as route restrictions, minimum shipment quantities per route, or capacity limits on specific warehouse-to-port links?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked a broad additional-constraints question and mentioned link capacity, but never explicitly asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, so the hidden truck-capacity slot was not recovered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no truck-capacity restriction to model; trucks can carry any number of containers or truck capacity is irrelevant to the optimization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly asked about truck capacity or max containers per truck, and the final READY_TO_MODEL model contains no truck-capacity constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Only the P2 truck-capacity slot was unresolved at stopping; no P0 or P1 hidden slots remained, so stopping was acceptable despite the P2 miss.

summary: The agent asked useful clarification questions about cost, equality constraints, integrality, and additional constraints, but missed the specific hidden truck-capacity limit. Since that slot is P2, the stop was appropriate, though the final model silently omits truck capacity.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
